identification: Realist painting of a sheep's head and fleece on a black ground, painted on the back board of an old open timber box/drawer used as a shadow-box frame, c.46x39 cm. Catalogued as Alison Cooper-White, a living Launceston-area painter (portraits and animals, often painted on old boxes and drawers; sells via Instagram/Facebook, Bluethumb and commissions). Lot estimate on the page is A$400-500.
